name: Sibex
desc:
Sibex is a Celtor NPC. They are a member of [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority) gone missing on duty.

Sibex dons a grey hood and wears an unconfirmed white outfit. They have a Gale Wisp that will circle them, constantly playing either a chaotic violin tune, whistles, and other various songs that resemble circus music.

Sibex resides on a cliff in [the Starswept Valley](location:the_starswept_valley) south-east of [the Lordsgrove](location:the_lordsgrove).

Sibex is capable of telling you your current Resonance progress, and what gives you the most Resonance progress. Once speaking to Sibex for the first time, they will prompt you to collect a Thresher Spine for them, and in return they will tell you the details of your Resonance obtainment method. Sibex will not take your Thresher Spine.

Sibex is able to unlock the Soul Beam Mantra when talked to upon meeting certain requirements:

-   Have the Chorus of Souls Talent; this Talent requires Oath: Oathless and 30 points in every Attunement.
-   Have Oath: Oathless.
-   Have a Resonance.
additional_info:
-   When talking to Sibex the song Sibex's Gale Wisp Tune will play.
-   Sibex mentions Warden Jericho, likely meaning they are under his orders. They've been described as missing on duty, the Authority appears to have just lost them.
-   They used to wear the Hive Leader's Garment outfit; this was changed in an update
    -   It may have been because the outfit's design was lifted from an outfit in _Genshin Impact_, but this is speculation.
-   Sibex's current outfit is nearly identical to and very likely based on that of Orsted from the anime _Mushoku Tensei_.
-   Back when the Dissonant modifier prevented you from obtaining a bell, instead of regular dialogue they would say: "\*He sighs.\* Gods below, I can already hear... utter silence!"
-   On the update of August 18th, 2025, Gale Wisp received a new model, but Sibex's Gale Wisp was not updated and still uses the old model.
-   Roblox clothing (current): Shirt / Pants
